Responsibilities:

 

SANCORP is seeking a Staff Officer III Expertise on DoD coordination to support the Office within the Office of the Under Secretary of Defense, Intelligence and Security (OUSD(I&S)) and its directorates. The following are examples of responsibilities: 

  • Provide daily operational support, offering in-depth strategic expertise for the development of operations security (OPSEC) policies, processes, and advisory services.
  • Support the oversight and advocacy of OPSEC Programs.
  • Provide input to briefings, staff summary sheets, information memorandums, action memorandums, and OPSEC Reports in accordance with DoDM 5110.01, Vol 1, “Manual for Written Material: Correspondence Management.”
  • Participate and contribute to policy development, strategy, and compliance meetings relevant to OPSEC.
  • Develop methods to provide oversight to generate data to evaluate OPSEC assess effectiveness. 
  • Periodically review OPSEC training curriculum designed for OPSEC practitioners to ensure the minimum relevant OPSEC training requirements are being met. 
  • Represent the OPSEC Division at key OSD and interagency- level meetings, prepare briefs and presentations, and solicit of input from OUSD(I&S) staff personnel for read-ahead/background information and point papers.
  • Initiate and closely manage the coordination and collaboration of DoD Component and interagency actions to facilitate DoD decisions on requests for DoD OPSEC support.
  • Apply expertise in DoD OPSEC policy needed to analyze and assess requests for DoD OPSEC policy support that meets the criteria DoD Directive 5205.02.
  • Support implementation of DoD OPSEC Program standards and assessment criteria. Support DoD OPSEC Program compliance and staff assistance program implementation.
  • Support execution of the DoD OPSEC Program assessment framework and periodic DoD OPSEC Program status reports.
